question.:question/problem:
How can we best describe the following matrix?

$$
A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 4 & -9 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

Choose the most specific listed description: identity before diagonal, and diagonal before upper or lower triangular. Choose Other only if none of these descriptions applies.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that $A$ is a matrix for which all entries above the diagonal are $0$'s:

$$
A = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 4 & -9 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

Therefore, it is a lower triangular matrix.

It is not an upper triangular matrix or a diagonal matrix since there is a non-zero element below the diagonal: ${a}_{31}=4\ne 0.$

question.:question/problem:
How can we best describe the following matrix?

$$
A = \begin{bmatrix}0 & 0 & 0 \\ -3 & 7 & 0 \\ -5 & 0 & -8\end{bmatrix}
$$

Choose the most specific listed description: identity before diagonal, and diagonal before upper or lower triangular. Choose Other only if none of these descriptions applies.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that $A$ is a matrix for which all entries above the diagonal are $0$'s:

$$
A = \begin{bmatrix}0 & 0 & 0 \\ -3 & 7 & 0 \\ -5 & 0 & -8\end{bmatrix}
$$

Therefore, it is a lower triangular matrix.

It is not an upper triangular matrix or a diagonal matrix since there is a non-zero element below the diagonal: ${a}_{21}=-3\ne 0.$
